title: Preparation of detergent-solubilized membranes from Escherichia coli
protocol: Resuspend the cell pellet from 1 l of E. coli culture in Lysis Buffer.
Passage through a French pressure cell at 20,000 psi to disrupt E. coli cells.
Centrifuge the sample at 10,000g for 10 minutes at 4°C to remove unbroken cells.
Ultracentrifuge the supernatant at 100,000g for 1 hour at 4°C.
Resuspend and homogenize the pellet containing E. coli membranes in Lysis Buffer.
Ultracentrifuge again to separate the membrane components.
Homogenize the pellet in 20 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 300 mM NaCl.
Ultracentrifuge at 100,000g for 1 hour at 4°C to remove water-soluble proteins.
Resuspend and solubilize the membrane pellet in 1% DDM, 20 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 300 mM NaCl, 10% glycerol, and 0.01% NaN₃ for 2 hours at 4°C under gentle agitation.
Ultracentrifuge the sample at 100,000g for 50 minutes at 4°C.
The supernatant represents solubilized membranes for further use.
